captions.caption: A soldier in full tactical gear begins to climb a rope ladder up the side of the military ship Frank Cable.
A close-up shot shows the soldier ascending the rope ladder against the ship's hull, with the water below.
The soldier continues to climb the rope ladder, with a concrete pier visible in the background.
The soldier makes steady progress up the rope ladder attached to the side of the ship.
A view from above shows the soldier climbing the ladder with determination.
The soldier continues their ascent, nearing the upper levels of the ship.
The soldier keeps climbing the rope ladder, pulling themselves up hand over hand.
The fully equipped soldier continues to climb the side of the large naval vessel.
The soldier reaches the top of the rope ladder and moves out of the frame.
A wide shot shows an empty upper deck of the ship overlooking the harbor.
The camera holds on the empty deck area with metal railings.
A soldier in tactical gear begins to climb over a railing onto the deck.
The first soldier is on the deck as a second soldier starts climbing over the railing.
The first soldier stands up with their weapon ready, providing cover for the second.
Two soldiers are now on the deck, moving forward with weapons raised.
A third soldier joins the first two as they advance across the deck.
The team of three soldiers runs across the open deck with their rifles at the ready.
More soldiers join the group as they move quickly across the ship's deck.
The scene changes to a long line of soldiers moving along a narrow exterior walkway.
A long column of soldiers in full gear moves in single file along the side of the ship.
The soldiers continue to advance along the ship's walkway, with the ocean visible beside them.
The camera follows the line of soldiers as they proceed along the exterior of the ship.
The scene changes to a soldier peeking over a metal ledge inside the ship.
A close-up shows the soldier cautiously looking over the edge before climbing.
The soldier begins to pull themselves up and over the interior ledge.
The soldier uses their arms to hoist their body over the grey metal structure.
The soldier is now halfway over the ledge, maneuvering their gear and body.
The soldier continues to climb, bringing their weapon over the ledge.
The soldier carefully brings their legs and rifle over the obstacle.
The soldier successfully gets over the ledge and onto the deck below.
After landing, the soldier quickly stands up and assumes a ready position.
The soldier aims their rifle forward as another person stands behind them.
The scene shifts to a view from behind a large anchor chain, showing soldiers inside the ship.
Several soldiers are positioned inside an open bay of the ship, with some aiming weapons.
The soldiers maintain their positions, providing security within the ship's interior.
A soldier kneels and aims their rifle while other personnel stand by in the background.
The soldiers hold their positions, securing the area inside the ship's forecastle.
The camera pans slightly, revealing more soldiers and Navy personnel in the background.
The scene changes to a wide view of soldiers in a rigid inflatable boat (RIB) at a pier.
A soldier jumps from the pier onto the RIB, which is filled with other military personnel.
The soldiers and sailors on the boat and pier prepare for their mission.
The RIB is docked alongside the concrete pier, with another boat visible in the background.
A closer shot shows the military personnel on the boat interacting and getting organized.
The group of soldiers and sailors on the RIB continue their preparations.
Personnel on the boat talk amongst themselves, with an American flag flying on the cabin.
The camera holds on the shot of the RIB filled with military personnel next to the pier.
The scene changes to the ship's bridge, where a sailor in an orange vest works at a console.
The camera pans left across the bridge, showing electrical panels and a watertight door.
The pan continues across the bridge's interior, showing various equipment.
A team of soldiers suddenly storms onto the bridge with their weapons raised.
The soldiers surround the sailor, shouting commands to get down and put their hands up.
The sailor complies with the soldiers' orders, putting their hands on their head.
The soldiers keep their weapons aimed at the sailor, securing the bridge.
A soldier moves in to restrain the sailor as the rest of the team provides cover.
A soldier handcuffs the sailor, who is facing a wall with their hands behind their back.
The soldier instructs the now-handcuffed sailor to get down on their knees.
The sailor is on their knees against a wall while the soldier stands over them.
The soldier checks the restraints on the sailor while other soldiers maintain security.
With the sailor secured, the soldiers continue to hold their positions on the bridge.
The shot holds on the restrained sailor and the soldiers who have taken control of the bridge.
